A mesma geração que roda dentro do site,: The same generation that runs inside the site, available as a call — charged against the same balance.
Quantos créditos restam e para onde fora: How many credits are left and where they went, so a customer can check usage without opening the dashboard.
Em créditos, não em número de requisiçõe: In credits, not in request counts. A call that generates an image costs many times one that reads the catalogue, and charging both at the same counter would get both prices wrong.
São os mesmos créditos que já valem dent: They are the same credits that already work inside the site: one balance, one statement, one price to understand. No parallel table to keep in sync.
Login, checkout, painel do aluno, admini: Login, checkout, the student portal, administration and the lesson text stay outside the public API — now and later. Each one is either the front door or the product itself. Neither belongs in open documentation.
Se você tem um caso de uso concreto, ele: If you have a concrete use case, it changes the order of the three fronts above. Tell us what it is — that is how we decide what to build first.
